title: Lakehouse Proxy Config Introduced (Breaking)
summary: Dataproc Metastore now exposes `LakehouseProxyConfig` for managing phased migrations to Lakehouse Iceberg REST Catalogs. This new configuration and its properties are read-only, which is a breaking change for any clients attempting to write to them.
details: The `Service` resource now includes a new `lakehouseProxyConfig` field, referencing the newly introduced `LakehouseProxyConfig` schema. This configuration enables routing requests for migrated namespaces to a Lakehouse Iceberg REST Catalog during phased migrations. Both the `lakehouseProxyConfig` field on the `Service` resource and its nested properties, `catalog` and `namespaces`, are explicitly marked as `readOnly`. This means developers cannot set these values; they are output-only, managed by the Metastore service. Any client code attempting to write to these fields will now encounter a breaking change and fail, as they are strictly server-managed outputs.
